title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waivers: Fee-Load Courtesy Point
content:
## Rule

A fee-load courtesy point applies to a Personal Loans courtesy waiver, counting the late fees and returned-payment fees charged on the loan fewer than 3 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the request date, the fee waived included: three or more give -0.2; exactly two give -0.1; one gives no point.

A point is added to the courtesy share by which the courtesy amount is taken; the courtesy share is held between zero and one. A negative point takes that much off the courtesy share.

| Late and returned-payment fees fewer than 3 whole months before the request | Point |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | -0.20 |
| exactly 2 | -0.10 |
| 1 (the fee waived) | none |

## Cases (hypothetical, request on 25 July)

- The late fee being waived (17 July), a returned-payment fee (3 July) and a late fee of 26 April: the 26 April fee is 2 whole months back and counts: 3 fees: -0.20.
- The same with the older late fee on 25 April: 3 whole months back, not counted: 2 fees: -0.10.
